name: OpenSSL Heartbleed out-of-bounds read
error: Trusted attacker-declared heartbeat length without proving payload buffer contained that many bytes.
fixed_by: Validate payload length before copying or returning heartbeat data.

name: Bash Shellshock command injection
error: Environment function parser executed command text trailing function definition.
fixed_by: Stop parsing after function definition and reject trailing command content.

name: sudo Baron Samedit heap overflow
error: Off-by-one and inconsistent escaping length accounting caused heap buffer overflow.
fixed_by: Use consistent unescape mode and exact destination-size accounting.

name: Log4Shell attacker-controlled JNDI lookup
error: Logging attacker-controlled text could resolve remote JNDI resources and construct objects.
fixed_by: Upgrade Log4j; remove unsafe lookup behavior and remote protocol support.

name: Spring4Shell unsafe data binding
error: Request data binding exposed a path to mutate sensitive class-loader-backed properties.
fixed_by: Upgrade Spring and deny dangerous binding paths at framework boundary.

name: MOVEit Transfer SQL injection
error: Unauthenticated request data reached SQL construction and enabled database reads/writes.
fixed_by: Apply vendor patch; parameterize queries and remove unauthenticated database reachability.

name: libwebp Huffman-table out-of-bounds write
error: Crafted WebP data drove Huffman table construction beyond allocated bounds.
fixed_by: Bound table construction and reject oversized invalid code-length combinations.

name: GitLab password-reset account takeover
error: Password-reset email could also be sent to attacker-controlled unverified address.
fixed_by: Send reset material only through verified account recovery destinations.

name: Rust BatBadBut Windows command injection
error: Windows batch-file argument quoting could not safely represent attacker-controlled arguments.
fixed_by: Upgrade Rust; reject unsafe batch arguments or avoid batch execution for untrusted input.

name: Express malformed-URL open redirect
error: Malformed URL encoding bypassed otherwise-correct redirect allowlists in res.location/res.redirect.
fixed_by: Upgrade Express to 4.19.2 or 5.0.0-beta.3 and retain strict redirect allowlisting.

name: PyYAML unsafe loader bypass
error: FullLoader allowed object construction paths leading to arbitrary code execution.
fixed_by: Upgrade PyYAML and use safe_load for untrusted documents.

name: Zip Slip archive path traversal
error: Archive entry names escaped extraction root and overwrote arbitrary files.
fixed_by: Resolve each output path and prove it remains inside extraction root before writing.
